name: NanoClaw
description: Small AI assistant that runs each agent in its own Linux container, with per-agent identity and memory in chat.
whatItDoes: Offers the core of an always-on personal assistant in a code base small enough to audit. Teammate agents can be spawned from chat, each with its own bot identity, container and memory, sharing rooms and canvases.
howItWorks: A single process coordinates agents that execute inside containers with filesystem isolation. The setup script installs Node, pnpm and Docker when missing, sets up a credential gateway and provisions a Slack app per agent.

requirements.name: Docker
requirements.description: Container runtime for agents, installed by the script if absent
